normalize_l2_embeddings: normalize rows of an embedding matrix using L2 normalization along the feature dimension
pairwise_cosine_similarity_all_pairs: compute a cosine similarity matrix between all rows of two embedding matrices
rowwise_cosine_similarity_corresponding: compute cosine similarity between corresponding rows of two equally sized embedding matrices
review_normalize_l2: review the normalize_l2 function to understand how it divides embeddings by their L2 norm
test_pairwise_cosine_similarity: test the pairwise_cosine_similarity function with two numpy arrays of shape size by embedding dimension
